label: final copy step of length-3 sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never on original tokens or <DEL>. Its strongest and most reliable firing is at the last copy step (t=5, outputting orig(2)) of L=3 sequences: almost every such step is active (precision 0.99), these hold the top activations, and they carry about half the activation mass. The remaining roughly 80% of active steps are weak (mostly <0.3 of max), spread over late copy steps (to_go 0-1) of longer sequences, especially L=4 and L=9. Rate there depends on the token fed back as input (x 8x lift, then r and f), with a weaker version at the step before the last in L=3 (t=4). It never fires on the first occurrence of an input token (in_first=1) or at recall_idx 0. This weak tail has no single clean description, so recall is low.
